text.jp: ……買い物に出ている今がチャンスか？
text.official_en: Speaking of my son...he’s out shopping right now. This might be a good chance to sneak out.

text.jp:
ある湖に、恐ろしい見た目の神様がいました。
人々はその神様を恐れ、遠ざけます。
text.official_en: Once upon a time, a god with a frightening appearance lived in a lake. The people feared the god and kept their distance from it.

text.jp:
いま、オルデリオンの街は大変でな……
船を出せないんだ。
text.official_en: Some bad things are going on in Olderion right now. I can’t go out to sea today.

text.jp:
いろいろ落ち着いたら、
すぐに駆け付けるつもりだがな。
text.official_en: I’ll sail right over to help once it’s safe again, though.
text.real_en: Once things settle down, I plan to rush right over there.

text.jp:
うちのおとうさんは
オルデリオンのまちで、おさかなをうってるんだ！
text.official_en: My daddy sells fish in Olderion!

text.jp:
うちの娘は街に嫁いだんだけど、
旦那がまた優しい男でね。
私に一緒に暮らさないかって言ってくれてるんだ。
text.official_en: My daughter got married and moved to the city. She’s graciously offered to let me live with them, but...
text.real_en: My daughter got married and moved to the city. Her husband is such a kind man. He's even invited me to live with them.

text.jp:
うちの爺ちゃん、
滝の回廊に行くのが趣味なんだ。
text.official_en: My grandfather loves to go to Waterfall Way.

text.jp:
うちは街にも負けない品ぞろえが売りなんだ。
見ていって損はさせないよ。
text.official_en: My stock rivals the wares of any big-city shop! No harm in taking a peek, am I right?

text.jp:
おとうさん、おさかなをたくさん
オルデリオンのまちにとどけるぞって、
はりきってるんだ！
text.official_en: My daddy was all excited! He said he was gonna bring a boatload of fish to Olderion!

text.jp: おとうさん、かっこいいね！
text.official_en: You’re so cool, Dad!

text.jp: おとうさん、きょうはつりにいかないの？
text.official_en: Aren’t you gonna go fishing today, Daddy?

text.jp:
このアムールは高い所にあるからな。
空気も澄んでいて気持ちいいだろう？
text.official_en: The air here is clear and clean because we’re so high up. Isn’t it refreshing?

text.jp:
これは、オルデリオンの民なら知らない人はいない
有名な昔話だよ。
text.official_en: That’s one of Olderion’s most famous legends. There isn’t a single resident who doesn’t know it.

text.jp:
しかし、ひとりの心優しい巫女が
そんな神様のために歌を歌いました。
text.official_en: But one day, a kindhearted maiden sang a song for the god.

text.jp:
そして、ふたりは心を通わせ、
神様は巫女が住む街を守ってくれるようになったのです。
text.official_en: The two forged a bond. From that day onward, the god resolved to protect the city where the maiden lived.

text.jp:
それにしても、海賊たちは
かなり熱心に仕事に励んでいるようです。
さすが、守り人さまのおかげですね。
text.official_en: I must say, I was shocked at how eagerly they took to the task. I suppose we have Master Nichol to thank for that.
text.real_en:
The pirates seem to be working
remarkably hard.
We have the Warden to thank for that.

text.jp:
だから、ここで暖を取っているの。
かまどの火の音を聞くと落ち着くしね。
text.official_en: That’s why I stay here by the fire. The crackling of the flames warms the heart as well.
text.real_en: That's why I warm myself here. The sound of the fire in the stove is so soothing.

text.jp:
ぼくもおおきくなったら、おとうさんみたいな
かっこいいりょうしになるんだ！
text.official_en: I wanna be a fisherman just like him when I grow up!
text.real_en: When I grow up, I want to be a cool fisherman like my dad!

text.jp:
みんなが、おとうさんのつったおさかなを
おいしいってたべるんだよ！
text.official_en: Everyone says the fish he catches taste really delicious!

text.jp:
オルデリオンは昔、水害の多い土地だったそうな。
それを、初代の水の守り人様が
水神様と契約し、治めたのじゃ。
text.official_en: Long ago, Olderion used to suffer from frequent floods. But that stopped when the First Maiden made a pact with the God of Water.
text.real_en:
Long ago, Olderion suffered frequent floods.
The first Warden of Water made a pact
with the God of Water and brought them under control.

text.jp:
メルセデス海賊団は北東の桟橋にいます。
どうかお気をつけて。
text.official_en: The Mercedes Pirates are docked at the jetty to the northeast of the town. Do be careful, sir.
text.real_en: The Mercedes Pirates are at the dock to the northeast. Please be careful.

text.jp:
元気なのはいいことだけど、
少し心配だよな。
text.official_en: I’m glad he’s still got the energy to do that, but I also can’t help but worry if he’s truly safe there.
text.real_en: I'm glad he's so full of energy, but I can't help worrying a little.

text.jp:
嬉しいんだけど、爺さんと暮らした
ここを離れる気も起きなくてねぇ……。
どうしたものか……。
text.official_en: I just can’t bring myself to leave when I have so many fond memories with my husband here. Oh, whatever am I to do...?
text.real_en: I'm happy about it, but I can't bring myself to leave the home I shared with my husband... What should I do...?

text.jp:
守り人の岬に道がかかったんですって？
ひと目でいいから見てみたいわ。
text.official_en: I heard you went out to Warden’s Cape. I’d love to see it for myself someday.
text.real_en: I heard they've built a road to Warden's Cape. I'd love to see it, even just once.

text.jp:
桟橋の海賊船は撤退したようですが、
まだまだ気は抜けないですね……。
text.official_en: The pirates seem to have withdrawn, but we mustn’t let our guard down.

text.jp:
水の守り人様には辛いお役目を
背負わせてしまっておるのでな……
わしらが支えていかねばならんのじゃ。
text.official_en: The Wardens of the Waters shoulder a heavy burden, so we must be there for them in any way we can.
text.real_en: We've placed such a heavy burden on the Warden of Water... We need to offer our support.

text.jp:
水の神殿は、初代の守り人さまの力で
守られているんです。
入るどころか、近づくこともできないんですよ。
text.official_en: The Water Shrine is shielded by the power of the First Maiden. Ordinary people can’t even approach it, let alone enter.
text.real_en:
The Water Shrine is protected by the power
of the first Warden.
No one can even approach it, let alone enter.

text.jp:
海賊たちが魔物の討伐を引き受けてくれたので、
私は引き続き町の警備に専念できます。
text.official_en: The pirates are hunting down the monsters for us, so I can continue to focus on protecting the town.

text.jp:
滝の回廊が近くにあるせいか、
この町少し肌寒いのよね……。
text.official_en: This town tends to be a bit chilly, perhaps because Waterfall Way is so close by.

text.jp: 滝の回廊を登ってきたのかい？
text.official_en: Ho there, young one. Did you climb up Waterfall Way?
text.real_en: Did you climb up Waterfall Way?

text.jp:
滝の激流にも負けない
丈夫な防具はいかがかな？
text.official_en: My armor can withstand the fiercest blasts of water!
text.real_en: How about some sturdy armor that can withstand even a waterfall’s raging torrents?

text.jp:
滝の裏側に入れるところを見つけると、
わくわくするだろう？
出たり入ったりしちゃってな……！
text.official_en: Isn’t it thrilling to discover places where you can go behind the waterfall? Going in and out of spots like that helps keep these old bones spry.
text.real_en: Doesn't it get you excited when you find a way behind a waterfall? I just can't resist going in and out...!

text.jp:
熱した鉄を澄んだ水にくぐらせる……
そうして焼き入れした剣は、切れ味も澄んでいるんだ。
見ていくかい？
text.official_en: Pour crystal clear water on heated metal, then temper the blade, and you’ll get a sword with a razor-sharp edge. Want to watch?
text.real_en: Dip heated iron into clear water... A blade tempered that way has a clean, sharp edge. Want to take a look?

text.jp:
神殿の周りには、
その力に惹かれた魔物が多くいるので、
お気をつけてくださいね。
text.official_en: There are many monsters drawn to the power of the Water Shrine. I’d be careful if you’re heading that way.

text.jp: 私の任務は、この町の警備であります。
text.official_en: It is my sworn duty to keep this town safe.
text.real_en: My job is to guard this town.

text.jp:
私も元気なうちは、まだまだ挑戦するつもりだよ。
息子には止められているがね！
text.official_en: As long as I have strength in me, no one can stop me from going where I like! Not even my son, try as he might!
text.real_en: As long as I'm still healthy, I intend to keep trying. My son keeps telling me to stop, though!

text.jp:
賑やかなオルデリオンの街もいいが、
ここみたいな穏やかな雰囲気が俺は好きなんだ。
text.official_en: I don’t mind the hustle and bustle of the city, but I much prefer a more laid-back place like this.
